name: Project Schedule Management
excerpt: Project Schedule Management involves knowing and influencing the schedule status and changes.
notes: Project Schedule Management focuses on understanding the status of the schedule, influencing factors that can cause schedule issues, determining changes, and managing them effectively. It includes concepts like slipped milestones and the importance of clear communication with sponsors.
context_summary:
- Focuses on schedule status.
- Influences factors causing schedule issues.
- Determines schedule changes.
- Manages changes effectively.
- Includes concepts like slipped milestones.
